scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.examples.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.examples.native.json
scripts.build: vp -C packages/one-map-react pack && vp -C packages/example-map pack
scripts.test: vp test run && bun run test:native && bun examples/mapbox-token.test.mjs && bun examples/inline-smoke-target.test.mjs && bun scripts/tf06-lifetimes-fixture.test.mjs && node scripts/native-smoke-process.test.mjs && bun scripts/native-smoke-process.test.mjs && node scripts/tf06-query-runner.test.mjs && bun scripts/tf06-smoke-selection.test.mjs && bun scripts/tf07-smoke-contract.test.mjs && node scripts/record-native-ui-observation.test.mjs && bun scripts/record-native-ui-observation.test.mjs && bun scripts/tf08-patches.test.mjs && bun scripts/native-location-permissions.test.mjs && node scripts/tf08-image-observations.test.mjs && node scripts/tf08-snapshot-errors.test.mjs && node scripts/tf08-final-observations.test.mjs && node scripts/tf08-pending-scope.test.mjs && node scripts/tf08-offline-observations.test.mjs && node scripts/tf08-offline-peers.test.mjs && node scripts/tf08-fused-location-fixture.test.mjs && node scripts/lint-policy.test.mjs && node scripts/tf09-rendering-fixture.test.mjs && node scripts/tf09-peer-patches.test.mjs && bun scripts/package-check-options.test.mjs && bun scripts/native-mapbox-version.test.mjs && node scripts/example-config.test.mjs
scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run check:docs && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:apps && bun run test && bun run test:package
scripts.pack: bun run build && mkdir -p artifacts && cd packages/one-map-react && bun pm pack --destination ../../artifacts --ignore-scripts
scripts.dev:web: bun run build && bun run --parallel --filter one-map-react --filter @one-map/example-map --filter @one-map/web dev
scripts.dev:expo: bun run build && bun run --parallel --filter one-map-react --filter @one-map/example-map --filter @one-map/expo dev
scripts.build:web: bun run build && vp -C apps/web build
scripts.build:expo:web: bun run build && bun run --filter @one-map/expo build:web
scripts.typecheck:apps: tsc --noEmit -p packages/example-map/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/expo/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:compiled: bun run build && vp test run --config vite.compiled.config.ts && jest --config jest.compiled.config.cjs --runInBand && node scripts/react-compiler.test.mjs
